policies.title: Guyanese ordinary passports: Albania visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Guyana's current Foreign Ministry outgoing schedule expressly states that Guyanese travellers do not require a visa for Albania for stays of up to 90 days.
conditions: The published exemption is limited to stays not exceeding 90 days; the source does not specify a separate rolling reference period.
Admission, passport validity, purpose-of-stay evidence, work, study, residence, transit and other individual requirements remain outside this ordinary short-visitor classification.
